name: JHD1313 LCD
description: Jinghua JHD1313 / AiP31068 character LCD at I²C 0x3e (Grove RGB module). Each write is [control, byte]: control selects the Instruction register (IR, 0x00 or Grove Co=0x80) or the Data register (DR, 0x40). HD44780 commands go to IR; character codes go to DR. Entry_Mode / Display_Control / Function_Set / DDRAM_AC are decoded shadows of what those commands programmed.

registers.name: Instruction
registers.description: HD44780 instruction register (IR). Zephyr init/clear/display writes [0x00, cmd]. Command classes by high bits: 0x01 clear, 0x02 home, 0x04 entry mode, 0x08 display on/off, 0x10 cursor/display shift, 0x20 function set, 0x40 set CGRAM addr, 0x80 set DDRAM addr.

fields.name: SET_DDRAM
fields.description: 1 = Set DDRAM address; bits 6:0 are the address (line 0 base 0x00, line 1 base 0x40).

fields.name: SET_CGRAM
fields.description: When bit7=0: 1 = Set CGRAM address (custom character generator).

fields.name: FUNCTION
fields.description: When bits7:6=00: 1 = Function Set (data length / lines / font).

fields.name: D
fields.description: Display on — meaningful when the write is Display Control (0x08|flags).

registers.name: Instruction_Co
registers.description: Same IR via the Grove control byte (Co=1). Seeed's library and Zephyr's auxdisplay_jhd1313 cursor_position_set write [0x80, cmd]. Often cmd is already SET_DDRAM|addr (0x80|col or 0xC0|col).

fields.name: SET_DDRAM
fields.description: 1 when this byte is a Set DDRAM Address command.

fields.name: ADDR
fields.description: Address field when used as Set DDRAM/CGRAM.

registers.name: Data
registers.description: HD44780 data register (DR). I²C write is [0x40, byte]. Bytes go to DDRAM (ASCII glyph) or CGRAM (custom pattern row) at the current address; the address then steps per Entry Mode.

fields.name: CHAR
fields.description: Character code (0x20–0x7E printable ASCII) or one CGRAM pattern row.

registers.name: Entry_Mode
registers.description: Decoded Entry Mode Set (HD44780 0x04|I/D|S). Updated when IR receives an entry-mode command; poking re-issues that command.

fields.name: I_D
fields.description: Increment (1) or decrement (0) DDRAM after each Data write.

fields.name: S
fields.description: Shift the entire display when the address moves.

registers.name: Display_Control
registers.description: Decoded Display On/Off Control (HD44780 0x08|D|C|B). Same flags the Controller inspector summarises.

registers.name: Function_Set
registers.description: Decoded Function Set (HD44780 0x20|DL|N|F). Grove/Zephyr init uses 8-bit, 2-line, 5×8 (0x38).

registers.name: DDRAM_AC
registers.description: Decoded DDRAM address counter (inspector address 0x81 — not an I²C control byte). Peek is 0x80|AC; poke issues Set DDRAM Address. Line 0 starts at AC=0x00, line 1 at AC=0x40.
